_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F01, a clue: the Collectors want a marked child alive.

text.zh_TW: 一張被踩爛的命令書：「帶走所有滿十二歲的孩子。有記號的那個，要活的。——灰面」
text.en: A trampled order: "Take every child of twelve winters. The marked one, alive. - Grey Mask"

text.zh_TW: 你低頭看自己的手掌。微光又亮了一下。
text.en: You look down at your palms. The glow flickers again.
